title: Um dia na vida de uma barista

text.title: A Day in the Life of a Barista
paragraphs: Maya is twenty-six, and she lives in Brooklyn, New York. She works as a barista in a small coffee shop near her apartment. Her day usually starts very early.
Maya [[gets up]] at five thirty every morning. She takes a quick shower, but she never eats breakfast at home. She always walks to work, because the shop is only [[ten minutes away]].
The shop opens at six thirty. The first [[customers]] are often nurses and taxi drivers. They don't have much time, so they order their coffee [[to go]]. Maya knows a lot of them by name.

In the afternoon, the shop is usually quiet. Maya cleans the coffee machines and [[restocks]] the cups and the milk. She finishes work at three. She takes a dance class [[twice a week]], and on Sundays she sometimes has dinner with her parents in New Jersey.

to go.note: Num café: "For here or to go?" = "Para comer aqui ou para levar?"

twice a week.note: once = uma vez, twice = duas vezes, three times = três vezes

grammar.title: Present simple: rotinas e hábitos
explanation: Usamos o present simple para falar de rotinas, hábitos e coisas que são sempre verdade. Por exemplo: Maya works in a coffee shop.
Com he, she e it, o verbo ganha -s: she works, she lives. Verbos que terminam em -sh, -ch, -ss, -x ou -o ganham -es: she finishes, she goes. E o verbo have vira has: she has dinner.
Na negativa, usamos don't (com I, you, we, they) ou doesn't (com he, she, it), e o verbo volta para a forma básica: they don't have, she doesn't eat.

Os advérbios de frequência (always, usually, often, sometimes, never) dizem com que frequência algo acontece. Eles vêm antes do verbo principal (she always walks), mas depois do verbo to be (the shop is usually quiet).

examples.pt: Ela sempre vai a pé para o trabalho.

examples.en: The first customers are often nurses.
examples.pt: Os primeiros clientes muitas vezes são enfermeiros.

exercises.explanation: Falso: ela nunca toma café da manhã em casa ("she never eats breakfast at home").

exercises.statement: Maya takes a dance class twice a week.
exercises.explanation: Verdadeiro: "She takes a dance class twice a week" (duas vezes por semana).

exercises.prompt: Complete com o verbo no present simple.
exercises.explanation: Com she (Maya), verbos que terminam em -sh ganham -es: finish → finishes.
Com they (the nurses), a negativa usa don't (do not) + o verbo na forma básica.

exercises.prompt: Complete com o verbo no present simple.
exercises.explanation: Com he (my brother), o verbo ganha -s: live → lives.

exercises.prompt: Coloque as palavras na ordem certa.
exercises.explanation: O advérbio de frequência vem antes do verbo principal: She always walks to work.
